*Submission 1 - Updated based on feedback*
##Clean and organize the three data sets, Covar, Gene Expression, and Gene Names. The initial check will be to look and see if data is complete. All columns and row names will be logical, with the correct type assigned to each variable. The variables will be factored where necessary. Gene Expression was transposed and the probeID, or x, was renamed to be gene from Gene Names data. 

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
library(tidyverse)
#Set seed for Jitter function 
set.seed(100)

#Upload all raw data and store them as "Raw" variables
covar_raw <- read.csv("GSE85307_covar-1.csv")
geneExpress_raw <- read.csv("GSE85307_geneExpression.csv")
geneName_raw <- read.csv("GSE85307_geneNames.csv")

#View summary to see completeness of data, commented out for readiblity
#summary(covar_raw)
#summary(geneExpress_raw)
#summary(geneName_raw)
#No incomplete (NA) cases found

#Assign to a new variable to leave raw data untouched
covar <- covar_raw[complete.cases(covar_raw),]
geneExpress <- geneExpress_raw[complete.cases(geneExpress_raw),]
geneName <- geneName_raw[complete.cases(geneName_raw),]

#Clean Covar data
#Found .* in online resource, indexing each value to make sure 
##it only contains the numeric, text, or date value. 
###Factoring variables where necessary based on type. 
#head(covar)
covar$preg_preeclampsia <- factor(sub(".*: ","", covar$preg_preeclampsia), 
                                  levels = c("Normal", "Preeclampsia"))
covar$batch_Microarray  <- sub(".*: ", "", covar$batch_Microarray)
covar$batch_Microarray <- as.Date(as.character(covar$batch_Microarray), 
                                  format = "%m/%d/%Y")

for (row in 1:nrow(covar)) {
  for(col in 3:10){
    if(col == 4 | col == 7){ }
    else {covar[row,col]<- as.numeric(sub(".*: ","", covar[row,col]))}
  }
}
covar$mat_asthma <- factor(covar$mat_asthma, levels = c(0, 1), 
                           labels = c("Healthy", "Asthmatic"))


#Compare to Raw to confirm values were accurately translated, 
##commented out for readiblity
#head(covar)

#Rename columns to be more identifiable 
names(covar)[names(covar) == "mat_age_yrs"]  <- "age"
names(covar)[names(covar) == "preg_preeclampsia"]<- "preeclampsia_status"
names(covar)[names(covar) == "delivery_gestAge_wks"]<- "delivery_wk"
names(covar)[names(covar) == "sampleCollection_gestAge_wks"] <- "collection_wk"
names(covar)[names(covar) == "batch_Microarray"] <- "collection_date"
names(covar)[names(covar) == "mat_BMI"]  <- "BMI"
names(covar)[names(covar) == "mat_vitD"] <- "vitD"
names(covar)[names(covar) == "mat_asthma"] <- "asthma_status"

#Prep for continuous to categorical data
covar$BMI_status <- ifelse(covar$BMI < 18.5, "Underweight",
                    ifelse(covar$BMI < 25, "Normal", ifelse(covar$BMI < 30, "Overweight", "Obese")))
covar$BMI_status <- factor(covar$BMI_status, 
                           levels = c("Underweight", "Normal", "Overweight", "Obese"))


#Check the result, commented out for readiblity
#head(covar)    

#Clean GeneExpressions:
#Rename X in geneExpression to the correct gene name from geneName, 
##rename col to gene
for (row_x in 1:nrow(geneExpress)) {
  for (row_gene in 1:nrow(geneName))
  if ( geneExpress[row_x, 1] ==geneName[row_gene,1]){
    geneExpress[row_x,1] <- geneName[row_gene, 2]
  }
}
names(geneExpress)[1] <- "gene"

#Confirm the gene name was translated correctly, commented out for readiblity
#head(geneExpress)

#Transpose geneExpress so each genes is a column
tp_geneExpress <- as.data.frame(t(geneExpress[, -1])) 

#Rename col names to the first row and remove the firstrow
names(tp_geneExpress) <- geneExpress$gene
tp_geneExpress$geoID <- rownames(tp_geneExpress)
rownames(tp_geneExpress) <- NULL

#Debugged this using AI since errors were occurring
covar[c(3, 5, 6, 8, 9)] <- lapply(covar[c(3, 5, 6, 8, 9)], as.numeric)  
tp_geneExpress <- tp_geneExpress[, c(ncol(tp_geneExpress), 
                                     1:(ncol(tp_geneExpress) - 1))]

#Check for correct transpose, commented out for readiblity
#head(tp_geneExpress)

#View summary to see completeness of all transformed data, 
##commented out for readiblity
#summary(covar)
#summary(tp_geneExpress)

merged_data <- merge(covar, tp_geneExpress, by ="geoID")
```

## Submission 1 Plots

```{r}
#Preparation for plots

#Define a theme
myTheme <- theme(
  # Remove grid lines and panel border
  panel.border     = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  # Axis text and lines
  axis.title       = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 14),
  axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
  axis.line        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
  # Backgrounds
  plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  # Title and legend
  plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
  legend.position  = "bottom",
  legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
  legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
  legend.key       = element_rect(fill = "white"),
  # Geometry color
  geom = element_geom(color="black", fill="darkgrey")
)
```


Histogram of Gene Expression:

Histogram of TRIB1 Gene Expression

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x=TRIB1))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = (mean(merged_data$TRIB1)+.03),color="black", 
             linewidth = 1, linetype="dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = (mean(merged_data$TRIB1)+0.03),y = Inf, 
           label = paste("Mean:",round(mean(merged_data$TRIB1), 1)),
           color = "black", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1,fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = (median(merged_data$TRIB1)+.03),color="blue", 
             linewidth = 1, linetype="dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = (median(merged_data$TRIB1)+0.02),y = 19, 
           label = paste("Median:",round(median(merged_data$TRIB1), 1)),
           color = "blue", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1,fontface = "bold") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of TRIB1 Expression",x = "TRIB1 Expression", 
       y = "Number of Samples")+
  myTheme
```


Scatterplot of Covariate vs. Gene Expression: 

Scatterplot of Material BMI by TRIB1

```{r}
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = BMI, y = TRIB1)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",formula = y~x, se = FALSE, color = "black", 
              linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 55, y = 9.50, 
           label = paste("r =", 
                         round(cor(merged_data$BMI, merged_data$TRIB1), 2)),
           hjust = -0.2, vjust = 1.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black")+
  labs(title = "TRIB1 Expression vs. Maternal BMI", x = "Maternal BMI", 
       y="TRIB1 Expression")+
  myTheme
```

Boxplot of Gene Expression Separated by Both Categorical Variables: 

Boxplot of TRIB1 Expression Separated by BMI and Preeclampsia Status

```{r}
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = BMI_status , y = TRIB1, 
                        fill = preeclampsia_status))+
  geom_boxplot( width = 0.7) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, 
                                             dodge.width = 0.8), 
             alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "lightblue")) +
  labs(title = "TRIB1 Expression by BMI and Preeclampsia Status",
       x = "BMI Status", y = "TRIB1 Expression", 
       fill = "Preeclampsia Status") +
  myTheme
```

*Submission 2*


```{r}

my_plotting_function <- function(data, list_of_genes, cont_var, cat_var, cat_cont_var )
  for(gene in list_of_genes){
    gene_mean   <- mean(as.numeric(paste(data[[gene]])))
    gene_median <- median(as.numeric(paste(data[[gene]])))
    
    #Histogram
    print(ggplot(data, aes(x=data[[gene]]))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = (gene_mean+.03),color="black", 
             linewidth = 1, linetype="dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = gene_mean+0.03, y = Inf, 
           label = paste("Mean:",round(gene_mean), 1),
           color = "black", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = (gene_median+.03),color="blue", 
             linewidth = 1, linetype="dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = (gene_median+0.03),y = Inf, 
           label = paste("Median:",round(gene_median, 1)),
           color = "blue", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 3,fontface = "bold") +
  labs(title = paste0("Distribution of ",gene," Expression"),x = paste0(gene, " Expression"), 
       y = "Number of Samples")+
  myTheme)
    
    #Scatterplot
    print(ggplot(data, aes(x = data[[cont_var]], y = data[[gene]])) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",formula = y~x, se = FALSE, color = "black", 
              linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 55, y = 9.50, 
           label = paste("r =", 
                         round(cor(data[[cont_var]], data[[gene]]), 2)),
           hjust = -0.2, vjust = 1.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black")+
  labs(title = paste0(gene," Expression vs. ", gsub("_", " ", cont_var)), x = gsub("_", " ", cont_var), 
       y= paste0(gene, " Expression"))+
  myTheme)
    
    #Boxplot
   print(ggplot(data, aes(x = data[[cat_cont_var]] , y = data[[gene]], 
                        fill = data[[cat_var]]))+
  geom_boxplot( width = 0.7) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, 
                                             dodge.width = 0.8), 
             alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "lightblue")) +
  labs(title = paste0(gene, " Expression by ", gsub("_", " ", cat_cont_var), " and ", gsub("_", " ", cat_var) ),
       x = gsub("_", " ", cat_cont_var), y = paste0(gene, " Expression"), 
       fill = paste0(gsub("_", " ", cat_var) , " Status")) +
  myTheme)
  }

my_plotting_function(merged_data, c("TRIB1", "SPAG9", "LGR4"), "BMI", "asthma_status", "BMI_status")
```
